caption: The drawing depicts four horizontal rectangular bands, each composed of woven patterns in various colors including shades of red, blue, brown, and a touch of white. The topmost band consists of alternating red, pink, and blue horizontal stripes with a wavy pattern. The second band features a sequence of blue, red, and white, with a pattern that includes small white ovals and alternating bands. The third band contains horizontal stripes of red, blue, and green, arranged in solid blocks across its width. The bottom band displays wide red borders on the top and bottom edges, with the central section consisting of narrow horizontal stripes of blue, brown, and black. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a handwritten signature "E. A. Williams." The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Shaker Chair Braids
